result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

- **Fix:** `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 6514) has a `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` condition, the same as the per-quarter and per-weekday purchase-order queries. I also added a sentence to its Javadoc saying cancelled orders are not counted.
- **Test:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` has a new `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` case covering your example. I added a status-taking overload of the test's `purchaseOrder` helper so it can create cancelled orders.
- **Result:** `mvn -o test -Dtest=SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes all 4 tests.

Nothing is committed.
